declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadratic.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadratic c₀ c₁ c₂ =
    Polynomial.C c₀ + Polynomial.C c₁ * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c₂ * Polynomial.X ^ 2

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace_nonneg_iff
declarations.type: ∀ (a t : ℝ), (∀ (c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace a t c₀ c₁ c₂) ↔ a = 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.signedTrace_quadratic
declarations.type:
∀ (a t c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.signedTrace a t (GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadratic c₀ c₁ c₂) =
    ↑(4 * c₀ ^ 2 + 4 * (t ^ 2 - a ^ 2) * (c₁ ^ 2 + 2 * c₀ * c₂) + 4 * (t ^ 4 - 6 * a ^ 2 * t ^ 2 + a ^ 4) * c₂ ^ 2)

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.witnessTrace.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (a t : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.witnessTrace a t =
    GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace a t (a ^ 2 - t ^ 2) a 1

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quartic_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ (a t : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quartic a t =
    Polynomial.X ^ 4 + Polynomial.C (2 * (a ^ 2 - t ^ 2)) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C ((a ^ 2 + t ^ 2) ^ 2)

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.even_test_trace
declarations.type: ∀ (a t : ℝ), GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace a t (a ^ 2 - t ^ 2) 0 1 = -16 * a ^ 2 * t ^ 2

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quartic_eval_roots
declarations.type:
∀ (a t : ℝ),
  ∀ r ∈ GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.roots a t,
    Polynomial.eval₂ Complex.ofRealHom r (GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quartic a t) = 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.roots.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (a t : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.roots a t =
    [↑t + Complex.I * ↑a, ↑t - Complex.I * ↑a, -↑t + Complex.I * ↑a, -↑t - Complex.I * ↑a]

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace
declarations.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace_eq
declarations.type:
∀ (a t c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quadraticTrace a t c₀ c₁ c₂ =
    4 * c₀ ^ 2 + 4 * (t ^ 2 - a ^ 2) * (c₁ ^ 2 + 2 * c₀ * c₂) + 4 * (t ^ 4 - 6 * a ^ 2 * t ^ 2 + a ^ 4) * c₂ ^ 2

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.signedTrace.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (a t : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.signedTrace a t p =
    (List.map (fun r => Polynomial.eval₂ Complex.ofRealHom r p ^ 2) (GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.roots a t)).sum

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quartic.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (a t : ℝ),
  GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quartic a t =
    ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C t) ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (a ^ 2)) *
      ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t) ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (a ^ 2))

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.witnessTrace_eq
declarations.type: ∀ (a t : ℝ), GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.witnessTrace a t = -4 * a ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + 3 * t ^ 2)

declarations.name: GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.quartic_eval_roots._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

declarations.name: GRWTSK.NumberTheory.Zeta.Riemann.riemannHypothesis_of_trace_extraction
declarations.type:
(∀ (s : ℂ),
    GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.NontrivialZetaZero s →
      ∃ W weight error L,
        0 < L ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ), W n = weight n * GRWTSK.Polynomial.ConjugateQuartic.witnessTrace (s.re - 1 / 2) s.im + error n) ∧
            (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ W n) ∧
              Filter.Tendsto weight Filter.atTop (nhds L) ∧ Filter.Tendsto error Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) →
  RiemannHypothesis
